track_a.decision: mantissa8_v1 (primary) run on the FULL 18-variant dataset (~371s estimated); k14_scaled_modulo_v1 run only on a representative SUBSET (one gray + one RGB image, chosen for variety: astronaut [portrait/high-entropy] and hubble_deep_field [low-entropy structured scene]) rather than the full dataset, since doubling to both profiles on all 18 variants (~742s) adds disproportionate runtime for a comparison Phase 4B already found statistically negligible at the image level across 63 synthetic images; a 2-image confirmatory subset is sufficient to check the finding replicates on natural images without re-running the full battery.

track_b.decision: Estimated 69 trials, ~1828s. This fits comfortably without reduction: plan is 5 images x 4 positions x 3 key/nonce configs (gray) + 3 per-channel trials x 3 configs on one RGB image = kept at this size (no further scale-back needed).
